workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: add seatbelt network_access test coverage and sandbox policy tracing

head_commit.message:
fix: add seatbelt network_access test coverage and sandbox tracing

- Add unit tests verifying network policy inclusion/exclusion in
  seatbelt args based on network_access true/false
- Add integration test that proves seatbelt actually allows/blocks
  socket creation based on the network_access flag (localhost only,
  no external network dependency)
- Add tracing to derive_sandbox_policy() logging the resolved sandbox
  mode, its source (cli-flag/config-toml/default), and network_access
  value — helps users debug when network is unexpectedly blocked

Ref: https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/10390

head_commit.message:
docs: add macOS seatbelt network sandbox troubleshooting to README

On macOS, `network_access = true` in config.toml is silently ignored
by the seatbelt sandbox, causing all outbound network calls to fail.
This adds a troubleshooting section with a confirmed workaround.

Ref: https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/10390
